message.content: {"findings":[{"severity":"major","location":"5.1 Principal interpretation","quote":"Along the task axis, the standard 𝑑 𝑘 divisor is significantly better than both alternatives on AG News at a 2-epoch budget — with large and medium paired effect sizes — yet statistically indistinguishable from them on two binary sentiment datasets.","issue":"The text claims "large and medium paired effect sizes" but doesn't provide specific effect size values or statistical tests to support this claim. Effect sizes should be quantitatively reported when claimed.","suggestion":"Report the exact effect size values (e.g., Cohen's d or similar) and corresponding statistical test results that demonstrate these large and medium effect sizes on AG News."},{"severity":"major","location":"5.2 Scale dependence and the near-uniform regime","quote":"attention entropy is pinned at 4.05 of a possible 4.16 nats for all variants","issue":"The entropy value (4.05 nats) is reported with two decimal places, but the maximum possible entropy (4.16 nats) is only given with two decimal places as well. This precision suggests measurement precision that isn't justified by the context.","suggestion":"Clarify the measurement precision of both the observed entropy and maximum possible entropy, or report with consistent precision."},{"severity":"minor","location":"5.3 Why would AG News care about the divisor?","quote":"pushing the softmax towards uniformity","issue":"The claim that the 1/𝑑 𝑘 divisor "pushing the softmax towards uniformity" is not supported by direct evidence in this paragraph. While it's implied by the variance argument, direct empirical evidence should be cited.","suggestion":"Provide direct empirical evidence (e.g., measured entropy values or softmax distribution statistics) that supports the claim about softmax uniformity."},{"severity":"major","location":"5.4 Sharper attention as a free improvement direction","quote":"the 2-epoch AG News result shows temperature effects can reach significance under matched conditions","issue":"The text claims temperature effects reached significance but doesn't specify the exact p-values or statistical test used to determine significance.","suggestion":"Report the exact p-values and statistical test results that demonstrate the significance of temperature effects on AG News."},{"severity":"major","location":"5.5 The early-training effect and its decay","quote":"every variant's validation loss bottoms at the same epoch (≈ 2 on SST-2, ≈ 1.6 on IMDB)","issue":"The epochs are reported with one decimal place (≈ 2.0 and ≈ 1.6), but the text doesn't clarify if these are exact values or approximations. The precision suggests exact measurements.","suggestion":"Clarify if these are exact epoch values or approximations, and provide the exact values if they are known."},{"severity":"minor","location":"5.6 Implications for experimental practice","quote":"the protocol used here — bit-identical initialization, shared data order, paired tests, Holm correction, effect sizes — is directly reusable by practitioners","issue":"The text claims the protocol is "directly reusable" but doesn't provide specific details about how to implement the bit-identical initialization or shared data order.","suggestion":"Provide specific implementation details or references for how to achieve bit-identical initialization and shared data order in the protocol."},{"severity":"major","location":"7 Conclusion","quote":"the standard divisor outperformed 1/𝑑 𝑘 and temperature 𝜏 = 2 on 4-class AG News (+0.31 and +0.10 percentage points, 𝑝 Holm < 0.05, 𝑑 𝑧 up to 1.52)","issue":"The text reports 𝑑 𝑧 values (which appear to be Cohen's d) but doesn't specify which effect size corresponds to which comparison (standard vs 1/𝑑 𝑘 and standard vs temperature 𝜏 = 2).","suggestion":"Clarify which effect size value corresponds to which comparison (e.g., "𝑑 𝑧 = 1.52 for standard vs 1/𝑑 𝑘 and 𝑑 𝑧 = X for standard vs temperature 𝜏 = 2")."}]}
